name: Grand Lagrangian Deployment (GLAD) drifter dataset
resolution: 5-min reporting intervals (position error < 10 m), low-pass filtered with a 1-h cutoff and subsampled to 15 min

scales.note: GLAD surface drifter deployment in Gulf of Mexico: July-September 2012 (~90 days), subsampled to 15 min; pair separations analyzed from ~10 m to ~1000 km.
